claims.text: The tomato and the potato both belong to the nightshade family, Solanaceae, and to the genus Solanum.
Cucumber, carrot and onion belong to other plant families than the tomato.
Aubergines (eggplants) and chilli peppers are also members of the nightshade family.
A tomato shoot grafted onto a potato plant can produce tomatoes above ground and potatoes below.
